name: Hive Shape — divergence, silence, mass, spread
summary: Look at every cubby in a hive at once and report its SHAPE — divergence (who disagrees about what the world is), silence (who did not answer, always named), mass (where the population actually lives), and spread (how unlike each other the members are). Private by construction: publishes nothing, writes no frame, and leaves the picture on the operator's machine.
tagline: A fleet of five with two unreachable is not a fleet of three.
author: RapterBox
